messages.author: ad188126f9138663
messages.subject: Re: readable plot?
parts:
Lies,
  This is a very complex model.  (I hope you have a large sample.)  So, it is going to pose a challenge.  The strategy that I would recommend would be to break that challenge down into a series of smaller challenges.  You might try something like this.
1. Begin working with manually drawn diagrams so that you can work out presentation strategies by directly editing the diagram.
2. Break up the measurement and structural portions of the model and present them on separate diagrams, one presenting a CFA and the other presenting what is essentially a path diagram for the latent variables (using circles).
3. Consider whether it is necessary to represent the mean structures in the diagram.
4. Use smaller double-headed arrows for the residual variances and see if you can rotate them to a more optimal position around the variable  to which they point.
5. Once you have worked out the presentation issues for separate diagrams, see re-evaluate whether it makes sense to attempt a combined diagram.
6. Once you have worked out a manually drawn diagram to your satisfaction, then consider whether it makes sense to reproduce it using code instead of manual construction.

Keith
